#!/bin/sh
set -eu

umask 077

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ] || [ -z "$1" ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s OUTPUT_DIRECTORY\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
logs=$(realpath -e -- "$base/logs")
out=$(realpath -m -- "$1")

case "$out" in
    "$logs"|"$logs"/*)
        printf 'export: output directory must not be inside logs/\n' >&2
        exit 64
        ;;
esac

if [ -L "$out" ]; then
    printf 'export: output directory must not be a symlink\n' >&2
    exit 73
fi
if [ -e "$out" ]; then
    if [ ! -d "$out" ]; then
        printf 'export: output path is not a directory\n' >&2
        exit 73
    fi
    if find "$out" -mindepth 1 -print -quit | grep -q .; then
        printf 'export: output directory must be empty\n' >&2
        exit 73
    fi
fi

parent=$(dirname -- "$out")
mkdir -p -- "$parent"
stage=$(mktemp -d -- "$out.tmp.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf -- "$stage"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

find -P "$logs" -type f -exec sh -c '
    root=$1
    destination=$2
    shift 2
    for source do
        relative=${source#"$root"/}
        target=$destination/$relative
        directory=${target%/*}
        mkdir -p -- "$directory"
        sed -E \
            -e '\''s/("auth_token"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*)"[^"]*"/\1"[REDACTED]"/gI'\'' \
            -e "s/('\''auth_token'\''[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*)'\''[^'\'']*'\''/\1'\''[REDACTED]'\''/gI" \
            -e '\''s/(auth_token[[:space:]]*[=:][[:space:]]*)"[^"]*"/\1"[REDACTED]"/gI'\'' \
            -e "s/(auth_token[[:space:]]*[=:][[:space:]]*)'\''[^'\'']*'\''/\1'\''[REDACTED]'\''/gI" \
            -e '\''s/(auth_token[[:space:]]*[=:][[:space:]]*)[[:alnum:]_.~+\/%=-]+/\1[REDACTED]/gI'\'' \
            -e '\''s/[[:alnum:]_%+.-]+@[[:alnum:].-]+\.[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]]*/[REDACTED]/g'\'' \
            -- "$source" > "$target"
        chmod 600 -- "$target"
    done
' sh "$logs" "$stage" {} +

find -P "$logs" -type l -exec sh -c '
    root=$1
    shift
    for link do
        relative=${link#"$root"/}
        resolved=$(realpath -m -- "$link")
        case "$resolved" in
            "$root"/*)
                printf "export: skipped symlink: %s\n" "$relative" >&2
                ;;
            *)
                printf "export: rejected symlink outside logs/: %s\n" "$relative" >&2
                ;;
        esac
    done
' sh "$logs" {} +

if [ -d "$out" ]; then
    rmdir -- "$out"
fi
mv -- "$stage" "$out"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
ANTRIEB_EXPORT_EOF
sh -n "$new"
chmod 700 "$new"
cp -p -- "$install_root/bin/export" "$install_root/bin/export.pre-repair"
chmod 700 "$install_root/bin/export.pre-repair"
mv -- "$new" "$install_root/bin/export"
